module: Low frame rate detector in freeroam and split screen (only freeroam and multiseatGamemode modes; missions, scenarios, career and tutorials are never monitored). When the smoothed FPS average stays below 25 for 5 s, it switches to a "low performance" state, displays a warning toast and can ask for confirmation before a new vehicle spawns (confirmSpawn). A modder who spawns vehicles can go through confirmSpawn to respect this warning.
notes: Constants: threshold 25 FPS, smoothing 5 s, enter after 5 s below the threshold, exit after 10 s above, grace period of 5 s, frames longer than 0.25 s ignored (considered loading stalls).
Detection is disabled (gate) if no level is loaded, mode not monitored, first drive (isFirstDriveActive), active OpenXR session, or FPS limit enabled at a value <= 25.
Sampling only happens if the screen is not fading, the game is not paused, the window has focus, the editor is inactive and the current UI route is "play"; otherwise the grace period restarts.
The notifyLowPerformance setting (false) turns off toasts, spawn warning and pause notice, but detection continues; in simple menu (Engine.UI.isSimpleMenu) notifications always stay active.
The ImGui debug window (onDrawDebug) exists in the file but its assignment is commented out: it is disabled.
The confirmation dialog's callbacks are referenced by Lua string (luaCallback), which makes these four functions callable from the UI.

isLowPerformance.desc: Returns whether the game is currently considered in low performance, and whether detection is still applicable (gate active).

confirmSpawn.desc: Executes spawnFn directly, unless the low performance state is active, the warning has not yet been shown for this episode and notifications are enabled: in that case displays a confirmation dialog (Cancel / Don't show again / Continue) and defers spawnFn.

returns.desc: Result of spawnFn if executed immediately (nil if it returns nothing), or false while the player has to decide.

confirmPendingSpawn.desc: Executes the pending spawn function, if any (Continue button).

cancelPendingSpawn.desc: Abandons the pending spawn function (Cancel button).

muteAndConfirmPendingSpawn.desc: Disables notifications (notifyLowPerformance setting = false), displays an info toast then executes the pending spawn.

getPauseNotice.desc: Returns the translated texts to display in the pause menu when low performance is active and notifications are allowed.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame update hook: periodically (1 s) checks the gate, manages the grace period, smooths the FPS and toggles the low performance state.

dtRaw.desc: Raw delta time in seconds, used for timing and FPS.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Vehicle spawn hook: restarts the grace period (spawning temporarily drops the FPS).

onScreenFadeState.desc: Screen fade state hook: sampling is suspended as long as the state is not 3 (fade finished).
